== Fields

=== `check`

A xref:guides:bloblang/about.adoc[Bloblang query] that should return a boolean value indicating whether a message belongs to a given group.

*Type*: `string`

[source,yaml]
----
# Examples:
check: this.type == "foo"

# ---

check: this.contents.urls.contains("https://benthos.dev/")

# ---

check: "true"
----

=== `processors[]`
